# Feature Announcement

`saas/feature-announcement` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

Announce a feature: badge, headline, description, key points, a button and a screenshot.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headline` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `badge` | text | `"New"` |
| `description` | text |  |
| `points` | listItems |  |
| `screenshot` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered text above a framed screenshot.
- **split**: Left-aligned text beside the screenshot. Sets `layout: split`, `align: left`.
- **tinted**: Stacked on the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `layout` | one of `stacked`, `split` | `"stacked"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored. The split layout is a table row, frame corners are square. | Fine. The split layout stacks on phones through a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/feature-announcement', {
  "badge": "New",
  "headline": "Shared workspaces are here",
  "description": "Invite your whole team, keep every project in one place and stop forwarding files.",
  "points": [
    "Unlimited members on every plan",
    "Comments and mentions on any item",
    "Roles and permissions per workspace"
  ],
  "screenshot": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/560x340/png?text=Workspaces",
    "alt": "Screenshot of the new workspace view with three projects and a team member list"
  },
  "cta": {
    "label": "Try workspaces",
    "href": "https://example.com/app/workspaces"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):
